name: GS-LRM
aliases: GS-LRM — Large Reconstruction Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting
Large Reconstruction Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that tokenizes two to four images and their camera parameters, concatenates them, and passes them through a transformer block whose output tokens are decoded into Gaussian parameters.
summary: GS-LRM is a feed-forward transformer that reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse views by directly predicting Gaussian parameters, bypassing iterative optimization.
